scope: Targeted evidence audit, not systematic review or personalized clinical prescription.
counting: 45 audited rows. Counts separate concrete sessions, primary main-set verification, coaching examples, and non-session frameworks. This is NOT 30 Sisu workouts and not 45 independent trials. See count_summary.
global_gates: Adult status, sport-specific training history, injury/illness/symptoms, goal, existing load, safe equipment/setting, adequate time and recovery. Unknown data fails closed. These are product/coaching review gates, not medical clearance or validated injury prediction.
general_progression: Unless explicitly study-described, progression/recovery rules here are JMM coaching inferences. Replace existing quality exposure instead of stacking all useful protocols. Preserve complete work/rest and truthful totals. No automatic increase from ambition or expert branding.
clinical_boundary: These studies do not supply a comprehensive contraindication list. Pain, unusual symptoms, illness, or relevant medical restrictions require stopping/review; chest pain, fainting or severe breathing difficulty warrant urgent medical attention. No personalized treatment advice is inferred.

count_summary.note: Full main-set verification is stricter than inspecting a workout. Warm-up, cool-down, individual eligibility, and safe automatic prescription are separate gates.

protocols.name: Running 4 × 4 aerobic intervals
protocols.population: 40 healthy moderately trained men; randomized four-arm, 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4 × 4 min at 90–95% HRmax; 3 min active recovery ~70%; 3 sessions/week.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Improved VO2 max; not race superiority.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts aerobic-power: similar work/rest; lower frequency and open targets
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Established running tolerance; no instant HR chasing.
protocols.progression: JMM: fewer complete bouts if labeled; no automatic study-frequency adoption.

protocols.name: Running 15/15 aerobic intervals
protocols.population: 40 healthy moderately trained men; randomized four-arm, 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 47 × 15 s / 15 s; 5.3% treadmill incline; 10 min warm-up and 3 min cool-down at 70% HRmax. Work associated with 90–95% HRmax, active relief at 70%.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: VO2 max outcome; short-bout HR lag matters.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.implementation_decision: Original main set verified; retain as research example or separately labeled adaptation
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Established runners; verify complete methods and intensity translation.
protocols.progression: No numeric progression verified.

protocols.name: Continuous lower-intensity running arm
protocols.population: 40 healthy moderately trained men; randomized four-arm, 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 45 min continuous at 70% HRmax; 5.3% treadmill incline; 3 sessions/week for 8 weeks.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Comparator, not optimal base prescription.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: aerobic-base is principle-level analogue
protocols.implementation_decision: Original main set verified; retain as research example or separately labeled adaptation
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Individual easy effort; no universal threshold claim.
protocols.progression: JMM: tolerated duration before intensity.

protocols.name: Continuous threshold running arm
protocols.population: 40 healthy moderately trained men; randomized four-arm, 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 24.25 min continuous at 85% HRmax; 5.3% treadmill incline; 10 min warm-up and 3 min cool-down at 70% HRmax.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Does not establish everyone’s LT2 at 85%.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Legacy threshold blocks differ
protocols.implementation_decision: Original main set verified; retain as research example or separately labeled adaptation
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Require sport-specific intensity review.
protocols.progression: No automatic duration escalation.

protocols.name: 10-20-30 running blocks
protocols.population: 18 moderately trained adults, 6 women/12 men; 7-week controlled study.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 3–4 × 5-min blocks, each 5 cycles of 30 s low, 20 s moderate, 10 s high; 2 min BETWEEN blocks. Original intensity <30%,<60%,>90% maximal intensity.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: 1500-m/5-km performance improved; does not validate novice near-maximal running.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.implementation_decision: Add effort-adapted, source-linked option after gates
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Prior running/speed tolerance; replace existing quality session.
protocols.progression: JMM: stable repeatability first; 3 → 4 blocks only after review. Warm-up/cool-down are separately labeled app choices.

protocols.name: Cycling 4 × 4-minute intervals
protocols.population: 35 recreational trained cyclists, 29 men/6 women; randomized four groups; 7 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4 × 4 min, 2 min BETWEEN bouts; 15 min warm-up. Two sessions/week for 7 weeks, maximum tolerable session effort; no universal FTP target.
protocols.evidence: Small randomized trial; original author-uploaded methods checked
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: 4 × 8 arm had largest combined physiological gain; not universal superiority or equivalent race gain.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.implementation_decision: Source main set verified; effort-adapted candidate with clearly separated JMM additions
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Cycling tolerance; observed HR is not FTP prescription.
protocols.progression: Do not stack the three trial arms; hold dose until response reviewed.

protocols.population: 35 recreational trained cyclists, 29 men/6 women; randomized four groups; 7 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4 × 16 min, 3 min BETWEEN bouts; 15 min warm-up. Two sessions/week for 7 weeks, maximum tolerable session effort; no universal FTP target.
protocols.evidence: Small randomized trial; original author-uploaded methods checked
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: 4 × 8 arm had largest combined physiological gain; not universal superiority or equivalent race gain.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.implementation_decision: Source main set verified; effort-adapted candidate with clearly separated JMM additions

protocols.name: Cycling 3 × 13 × 30/15
protocols.population: 18 elite male cyclists; 3-week intervention; 9 sessions.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 3 × [13 × 30 s work + 12 × 15 s recovery], 2 × 3 min between sets: 34.5 min main set. Fifteen-minute individualized warm-up; cool-down not specified.
protocols.evidence: Small counterbalanced controlled intervention; full primary methods
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Some performance measures favored short intervals; not universal or cross-sport proof.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: prescription.ts legacy 30/15 PARTIAL: budget-scaled, lacks exact 3 × 13 grouping
protocols.implementation_decision: Candidate advanced adaptation; preserve all set rests
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: National-level cyclists with high baseline volume; maximal sustainable session effort. Recovery power was 50% of work power; no FTP equivalence.
protocols.progression: Review as finite block; do not add to existing full HIIT frequency.

protocols.name: Cycling 4 × 5-minute intervals
protocols.population: 18 elite male cyclists; 3-week intervention; 9 sessions.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4 × 5 min work + 3 × 2.5 min recovery: 27.5 min main set; 15 min individualized warm-up.
protocols.evidence: Small counterbalanced controlled intervention; full primary methods
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Valid studied comparator, not proof of optimum.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Legacy 3 min 1: 1 differs
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: National-level cyclists with high baseline volume; maximal sustainable session effort. Recovery power was 50% of work power; no FTP equivalence.
protocols.progression: JMM: review completion before more work.

protocols.name: Wingate-style cycling 4–6 × 30 seconds
protocols.population: 16 moderately active men; 2-week comparison.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4–6 × 30 s all-out cycling; 4 min recovery; 6 sessions/2 wk.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Short-term muscle/performance adaptation; not general endurance replacement.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: anaerobic-capacity uses 30 s hard/2 min, explicitly different
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Suitable ergometer and supervision; all-out tolerance unverified in app.
protocols.progression: Study progression is not an autonomous beginner progression.

protocols.name: Cycling 8–12 × 60/75
protocols.population: 7 young men; 6 sessions over 2 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 8–12 × 60 s at~100% ramp-test peak power; 75 s recovery.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Muscle oxidative markers and cycling tests improved; very small sample.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.implementation_decision: Add explicitly effort-adapted 8 × 60/75; not trial replication
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: PPO is not FTP; no inferred watts; prior HIIT tolerance.
protocols.progression: JMM: 8 bout start; no automatic 8 → 12 ramp or shortened rests.

protocols.name: Original Tabata cycling
protocols.population: Small male laboratory samples; high-intensity arm n 7.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 7–8 × 20 s at~170% VO2 max-associated power; 10 s rest; 6-week training.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Aerobic/anaerobic outcomes; 20/10 bodyweight circuits are not equivalent.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Exhaustive supramaximal cycling; supervision and test anchor absent.
protocols.progression: Do not import high weekly frequency or all-out to novices.

protocols.name: Cycling 3 × 20-second sprint intervals
protocols.population: 27 sedentary men enrolled, 25 completed; matched assignment, 12 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 2 min 50 W warm-up; 3 × 20 s all-out with 2 min 50 W BETWEEN; 3 min 50 W cool-down; 10 min total.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Cardiometabolic/fitness markers, not race equivalence.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe found
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Lab familiarization; 50 W and~500 W are not universal targets.
protocols.progression: Study: 1 session week 1, 2 week 2, 3 thereafter; not automatic clearance.

protocols.name: Cycling 45-minute moderate continuous
protocols.population: 27 sedentary men enrolled, 25 completed; matched assignment, 12 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 45 min~70% HRmax +2 min warm-up/3 min cool-down at 50 W; 50 min total.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Improved fitness/metabolic markers; limited sample.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: aerobic-base can represent effort-adapted structure
protocols.implementation_decision: Retain base; optional explicit 50 min variant
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Test-guided 64–76% HRmax used; easy watts individualized.
protocols.progression: Study lead-in as above; app effort adaptation must be labeled.

protocols.name: Single 6 × 10-minute uphill threshold-like session
protocols.population: 14 trained men: 11 national-level cross-country skiers and 3 runners; acute counterbalanced crossover.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 6 × 10 min at 90% speed at 4 mmol/L, 10.5% incline; 2 min between.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: More drift than split; no chronic adaptation or injury proof.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Review-only dossier; no exact executable recipe
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Laboratory intensity; very large work volume; not flat-run pace equivalent.
protocols.progression: No longitudinal progression established.

protocols.name: Split 3 × 10-minute sessions
protocols.population: 14 trained men: 11 national-level cross-country skiers and 3 runners; acute counterbalanced crossover.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Two 3 × 10 min sessions, 6.5 h apart; same intensity; 2 min between reps. Each 20 min warm-up+15 min cool-down.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Lower acute strain; single arm had extra easy session for matching.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Review-only doubles guidance; not executable
protocols.implementation_decision: Keep coach review-only; redistribute rather than add
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Experienced athletes, refueling, time, between-session reassessment.
protocols.progression: No evidence that mandatory weekly doubles improve races.

protocols.name: Pool swimming short maximal repeats
protocols.population: 41 elite swimmers randomized; 12 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 6–10 × 10–30 s maximal; 2–4 min rest; training distance halved, HIIT increased.
protocols.evidence: Randomized trial with null group effect
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: 100/200 m and physiological outcomes did not improve versus usual training; not equivalence proof.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Generic swim protocol not exact trial
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Elite pool skills and supervision; no open-water/breath-hold transfer.
protocols.progression: No automatic volume-to-HIIT exchange.

protocols.name: Heavy half-squat adjunct
protocols.population: 17 well-trained runners, 9 men/8 women; randomized 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Free-weight half-squat 4 × 4 RM, 3 min rest BETWEEN sets, 3 sessions/week for 8 weeks.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Economy and time-to-exhaustion improved; not same percentage race gain.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: strength foundation differs; dossier-only exact dose
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Familiar lifter with technique/load review; no inferred 1 RM.
protocols.progression: Study added 2.5 kg after a successful five-repetition set; requires qualified lifting review, not automatic JMM progression.

protocols.name: Female endurance-athlete heavy-leg program
protocols.population: 19 well-trained female endurance athletes; randomized 11 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Half-squat, unilateral leg press, standing unilateral hip flexion, ankle plantar flexion; 3 sets each. Alternating 10/6 RM in weeks 1–3, 8/5 RM in weeks 4–6, 6/4 RM in weeks 7–11. Interset rest not specified in this article.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Strength/jumps improved; 40 min running performance and economy did NOT.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: strength foundation analogue only
protocols.implementation_decision: Retain supporting-strength rationale; no race guarantee
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Appropriate lifting familiarity and total-load review.
protocols.progression: Study used supervised repetition-maximum work to failure, occasionally assisted final reps; do not import failure or assistance as defaults.

protocols.name: Whole-body 20/10 conditioning
protocols.population: 22 recreationally active young women; 4 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 8 × 20 s one exercise(session: burpees, jumping jacks, mountain climbers, or squat thrusts), 10 s rests; 4 days/week.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Aerobic fitness/local endurance; not same as original Tabata cycling.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: muscular-endurance analogue, different reps/rest
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Impact/movement tolerance; not compulsory HYROX dose.
protocols.progression: Do not extrapolate 4 days/week into mixed-sport plan.

protocols.name: Judo uchi-komi intermittent conditioning
protocols.population: 35 judo athletes randomized 4 groups; 4 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 5 min technical warm-up + 3 min rest, then 2 × [10 × 20 s uchi-komi with 9 × 10 s rests], 5 min between blocks: 22 min 40 s total. Throw partner at the end of each work bout.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Selected laboratory power outcomes; not competition win rate.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No reviewed combat protocol; boxing legacy is not judo
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Qualified judo supervision; partner matched within ±10% body mass in study; safe throwing skill and normal training load review.
protocols.progression: No generic progression or conversion to striking.

protocols.name: Boxing heavy-bag repeated sprints
protocols.population: 16 elite male boxers; 4-week randomized comparison.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 3 rounds × 14 × 3 s maximal heavy-bag punches, 10 s between repeats, 1 min between rounds; 3 sessions/week. Table 1 clarifies 42 sprints.
protocols.evidence: Small randomized trial; full methods and correction reviewed
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Selected anaerobic/punch measures; some between-group results nonsignificant.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Generic boxing structure not exact dose
protocols.implementation_decision: Research-only all-out specialty; correction concerns equipment-image AI disclosure, not scientific dose
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Experienced boxers; bag technique, wrist/shoulder tolerance; not sparring.
protocols.progression: No safe automatic progression established.

protocols.name: JMM strength foundation
protocols.population: Healthy-adult synthesis; expert teaching.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM: 3 patterns, 2–3 × 5 reps, 3 min rest; beginner 6 reps/2 min; 2–3 RIR.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Not exact trial or Galpin quote.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts strength EXECUTABLE
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Familiar safe movements; no maximal test requirement.
protocols.progression: JMM: increase load only after repeated good completion.

protocols.name: JMM hypertrophy session
protocols.population: Healthy-adult network meta-analysis.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM: 4 patterns, 2–3 × 10, 2 min rest;~2 RIR.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Multiset work supports growth; no mandatory failure.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts hypertrophy EXECUTABLE
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Count overlapping work; adequate recovery.
protocols.progression: JMM: reps before load/sets; avoid mandatory 20 sets.

protocols.name: JMM low-fatigue power session
protocols.population: Healthy-adult overview of 137 reviews.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM: 2 movements, 2–3 × 3 reps, 3 min rest; fast intent.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Fast concentric work supports power; not exact workout proof.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts power EXECUTABLE
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Start feet-grounded; landing skill needed for jumps.
protocols.progression: Quality before load; stop clear slowing.

protocols.name: JMM local muscular endurance circuit
protocols.population: Healthy-adult synthesis/expert education.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM: 2–3 rounds squat, incline push-up, bridge; up to 20 reps; 45 s rest.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Local endurance differs from aerobic base.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts muscular-endurance EXECUTABLE
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Use safe familiar movements; avoid technique-failure chasing.
protocols.progression: JMM: comfortable repetitions before extra resistance.

protocols.name: Acceleration quality session
protocols.population: Sprint science/elite-practice review, not RCT.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Practice range 10–50 m with full recovery; development examples 20 m/~2 min rest.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: No universal distance or injury-safe dose.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: speed generic 6 s plus sprint library PARTIAL
protocols.implementation_decision: Retain generic; distance version needs coaching
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Surface, warm-up, sprint history and technique required.
protocols.progression: Preserve rest and repeat quality; no universal 5% safety cutoff.

protocols.name: Flying maximal-speed session
protocols.population: Same review; elite-practice context.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Flying 10–30 m with individualized run-in; development example 10 m/~4 min rest.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Distinct from acceleration and fatigue intervals.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Sprint library may hold examples; no reviewed full athlete-specific recipe
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Sprint-trained athlete, measured speed, qualified technical supervision.
protocols.progression: Quality first; do not shorten rest to force fatigue.

protocols.name: CSS-guided pool aerobic repeats
protocols.population: Critical-speed measurement study: 32 national-level swimmers.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM review example 6–10 × 100 m near estimated CSS, 15–30 s rest. This workout was NOT tested by CSS study.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: CSS estimate not measured lactate threshold; stroke/pool-specific.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: reviewed-cycle-samples swim REVIEW-ONLY
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Water safety, stroke skill; verified same-pool/stroke tests.
protocols.progression: JMM: technique and repeatability before repeats; no fatigue-max testing.

protocols.name: Technique-first easy swim
protocols.population: Expert adaptation framework; no session RCT.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Short easy skill-focused repeats with individualized rest; no evidence-validated numeric dose asserted.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: General framework cannot validate swimming-specific biomechanics.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: aerobic-base swim/legacy repeats PARTIAL
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Competence, supervised water; never breath-hold challenge.
protocols.progression: Coach changes one technique/task component at a time.

protocols.name: Partial run–station HYROX combinations
protocols.population: 11 recreational HYROX participants; simulation/correlation study.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM: partial controlled run–station repeats; no optimal set count/dose established.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Running and stations matter; correlation does not validate weekly simulation.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: prescription.ts hyroxSteps generic EXECUTABLE; review cycles separate
protocols.implementation_decision: Retain with heuristic label; no evidence-backed numeric upgrade
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Division-specific load, station technique, mechanical fatigue; review total quality load.
protocols.progression: JMM: increase only one distance/load/station component after tolerance.

protocols.name: Easy bike-to-run transition brick
protocols.population: 15 moderately trained triathletes, 11 men/4 women; 6 week pilot.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM transition-practice combination; no exact brick dose was validated by this study.
protocols.evidence: Indirect sport context, not brick trial
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Distribution pilot cannot prove bricks improve race outcomes.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: reviewed-cycle-samples triathlon REVIEW-ONLY
protocols.implementation_decision: Keep review-only until explicit design/transition approval
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Combined-load accounting; novice cycling is not novice running clearance.
protocols.progression: JMM: first practice transitions at easy effort; no compulsory extra hard session.

protocols.name: Triathlon polarized-distribution block
protocols.population: Same 6 week pilot; minimization allocation.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Polarized versus moderate-intensity distribution, similar total hours.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: No significant group × time differences; not polarized superiority.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Training cycle intent exists; reviewed sample not automatic
protocols.implementation_decision: Retain distribution choice, not fixed 80/20 law
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Count quality across all sports together.
protocols.progression: Change distribution by phase and actual response, not rigid quotas.

protocols.name: Competition taper protocol
protocols.population: Meta-analysis 27 competitive-athlete studies.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: ~2 weeks, 41–60% volume reduction, retain some intensity/frequency: synthesis pattern, not universal exact schedule.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Taper context; no guaranteed race-time benefit.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: cycle/review examples include taper PARTIAL
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Actual event/date/priority required; avoid full hard volume under maintain intensity.
protocols.progression: Reduce volume while assessing fatigue; post-event response unknown.

protocols.name: Conversational aerobic-base session
protocols.population: Talk-test experimental source; not universal threshold test.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: JMM20–90 min comfortable effort; duration is coaching choice.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Talk test supports regulation, not laboratory LT1 measurement.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: protocols.ts aerobic-base EXECUTABLE
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Appropriate modality and comfortable breathing; no forced nasal-only rule.
protocols.progression: JMM: consistent tolerated volume before intensity; no fixed 10% safety rule.

protocols.name: Cycling 10-second sprints / 1-minute recovery
protocols.population: 14 physically active men; matched assignment; 6 supervised sessions over 2 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 4–6 × 10 s all-out cycling; 1 min recovery; 5 min warm-up at approximately 30% MAP; friction load 7.5% body mass.

protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Not an exact reviewed runtime recipe
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Study used supervision and 1–2 rest days between sessions.
protocols.progression: Study advanced 4, then 5, then 6 repetitions across pairs of sessions; not individualized clearance.

protocols.population: 30 male collegiate basketball players randomized; 6 weeks.

protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Basketball-trained athletes; safe deceleration space and supervised technique.
protocols.progression: Study increased repetition counts every two weeks; do not transfer directly to distance runners.

protocols.name: Running 8 × 20-second supramaximal intervals
protocols.population: 81 aerobically well-trained women randomized across 3 groups; 49 finally analyzed; 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Approximately 8 × 20 s at initial ~150% MAS, 10 s passive recovery; 10 min warm-up including short supramaximal bouts; 10 min cool-down. Motorized treadmill set at approximately 3° inclination, not 3% grade.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: No VO2 max improvement in this SIT arm; sprint outcomes differ from aerobic goals.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Not exact reviewed runtime recipe
protocols.implementation_decision: Research-only; not a VO2 max default
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: One-to-one supervision; final bout exhaustion; MAS cannot be inferred from 5 km or FTP.
protocols.progression: Study increased intensity if ninth bout completed; unsuitable automatic rule.

protocols.name: Running 10 × 30-second all-out intervals
protocols.population: 81 aerobically well-trained women randomized across 3 groups; 49 finally analyzed; 8 weeks.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: 10 × 30 s all-out, 3.5 min active recovery at ≤70% HRmax; ~175% MAS observed average. Motorized treadmill set at approximately 3° inclination, not 3% grade.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Eight injuries in this arm (six hamstring, one calf, one fall), about 30% of those assigned. This is a study-specific signal, not a universal injury probability for women.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: Legacy 30/90 is different and not validated by this trial
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: High mechanical risk and explicit adverse-event signal; specialist review only.
protocols.progression: No automatic progression; do not interpret study dose as recommendation.

protocols.name: Galpin-discussed Sugarcane distance challenge
protocols.population: Expert podcast teaching, chapter 03: 11: 45; no efficacy trial identified.
protocols.verified_dose_or_labeled_example: Round 1: cover distance in 2 min. Round 2: repeat that distance and record time. Round 3: use round-2 time and try to exceed round-1 distance. Two-minute inter-round rest recommended.
protocols.validated_scope_and_limit: Not fixed six-minute work: round-2 and round-3 duration can vary.
protocols.baseline_code_mapping: No exact reviewed runtime recipe
protocols.implementation_decision: Keep as expert example, not validated prescription
protocols.eligibility_and_recovery: Distance/time measurement, prior hard-session tolerance; no automatic failure challenge.
protocols.progression: No evidence-validated progression or universal superiority.
